text: Till 6 soil tiles with the hoe
hint: Select the hoe (slot 1) and press Action on bare ground.
Pick seeds on the hotbar and press Action on tilled soil.
Equip the can and press Action on crops. Refill at the pond.

text: Sleep in bed to grow your crops
hint: Walk into the house and use the bed with Interact.

text: Pick up 3 wild goods off the ground
hint: Look for sparkling goods on the ground and press Action.

text: Buy 5 items at the General Store
hint: Walk south through the gate to town for more seeds.
Ripe crops are full-grown. Press Action on them.
Put crops in the bin beside the house with Interact.

text: Catch a fish with the rod
hint: Equip the rod, face water and press Action. Tap on the bite!

text: Fill an order on the town board
hint: Go to the board in town and use Interact.
Open Menu > Craft. Fertilizer needs fiber from cut weeds.

text: Place a sprinkler or a jar
hint: Craft a sprinkler or jar, then press Action on bare ground.

text: Make a jar of jam or pickles
hint: Load fruit or vegetables into a jar and collect in 3 days.
Put fertilizer on tilled soil before planting.
Walk up to someone with a ! and press Interact.

text: Raise your first chicken in a coop
hint: Craft a coop, place it, then buy a chicken in town.
Feed your animals every day. Products wait each morning.
Buy a sapling in the shop's Animals tab and plant it.
Chat daily and give gifts they like.
Grow valuable crops and sell jam, eggs and fish.

text: Buy an upgrade in the shop
hint: Open the shop and check the Upgrades tab.
Add sprinklers and more plots to grow faster.
Find a for-sale sign on the farm and use Interact.
Keep every jar and keg loaded, then collect.
Cast at the pond, town river or woods lake.

text: Fill 10 orders on the town board
hint: Check the board each morning and plan your harvest.
Chat every day and give gifts they love.
Reach 2 hearts with someone, then talk to them again.
Build machines and houses to grow your income.
Go north on the woods trail to the mine. Use the pickaxe.

text: Smelt a bar in a furnace
hint: Craft a furnace (Mining 2), load ore and wait 2 days.

text: Upgrade a tool with metal bars
hint: Bring bars to the shop and open the Upgrades tab.
On a festival day, open the town board and enter something.
Open Menu > Book and find every good on a page.
Feed every day and visit the coop, barn and bees.
Keep every field, jar and animal working each day.
